scope: All production TypeScript callsites that invoke the authoritative executeEffect gateway
classification: Local executable coverage only; protected source and live-account proof remain deferred

entries.account: Local operator process; provider account is resolved inside the child
entries.credential: buildSafeChildEnv removes provider and authorization credentials before launch
entries.normalization: Command and argument JSON is SHA-256 bound to the operation or session id
entries.policyDecision: Durable pending claim, kernel assessment, exact ask approval when required, then started
entries.receipt: Acknowledgement and readback hashes project to canonical WorkItem, Run, and Receipt records
entries.compensation: No automatic consequential retry; uncertain launch settles unknown and needs human

entries.actor: Exact registered tool name and stable provider call id
entries.account: Local project or provider account owned by the selected tool
entries.credential: The adapter retains only normalized payload SHA-256; credentials stay in the tool or provider boundary
entries.normalization: Canonical recursively sorted arguments, tool name, session, stable operation id, target class, and SHA-256
entries.policyDecision: The durable pending claim precedes kernel assessment and exact approval; unclassified tools default into this gateway
entries.executor: executeToolEffect invokes the registered tool exactly once and never automatically retries consequential effects
entries.receipt: Canonical effect journal records pending, started, outcome, acknowledgement, readback hash, and WorkItem settlement
entries.compensation: Explicit denied, expired, unknown, and compensated tool truth is preserved; ambiguous operations require human readback

entries.account: Local loop or factory process and configured webhook target
entries.credential: Child environment is scrubbed; webhook authentication remains in the configured resolver
entries.normalization: Child target or reply bytes are SHA-256 bound to stable launch or delivery keys
entries.policyDecision: Missing gate blocks; executeEffect performs durable claim, kernel decision, and exact approval
entries.executor: Detached child spawn or configured webhook deliver function
entries.receipt: Launch acknowledgement or delivery settlement projects through the shared effect journal
entries.compensation: Lock and idempotency prevent duplicate launch; uncertain delivery requires readback

entries.account: Exact configured messaging platform and channel
entries.credential: Platform adapter owns credentials; bodies and authorization headers never enter the journal
entries.normalization: Platform, channel, message or file bytes, payload SHA-256, and caller idempotency key
entries.policyDecision: Missing gate blocks; durable claim and kernel/approval decision precede provider send
entries.receipt: Provider transport acknowledgement plus readback SHA-256 settles verified or unverified truth
entries.compensation: No blind retry; missing acknowledgement fails and uncertain send settles unknown

entries.credential: buildMcpChildEnv exposes only explicit MCP configuration and excludes provider credentials
entries.normalization: Command, arguments, environment-key names, session, and SHA-256 bind launch identity
entries.policyDecision: Shared gateway decision occurs before transport creation or initialization
entries.receipt: Launch acknowledgement is metadata-only and projects to the canonical effect journal
entries.compensation: Failed initialization closes transport; uncertain launch is not replayed automatically

entries.account: Named local or remote MCP server
entries.credential: OAuth token resolution remains inside connector state and is excluded from intent persistence
entries.normalization: Server description, target class, session, connector name, and SHA-256
entries.policyDecision: Connection and discovery start only after durable claim and kernel/approval decision
entries.receipt: Connected status and server acknowledgement settle through the shared effect journal
entries.compensation: Failed or OAuth-required connection closes resources and remains retry-explicit

entries.credential: Transport owns credentials; only argument SHA-256 is retained
entries.normalization: Server, tool, effect call id, argument SHA-256, and idempotency key
entries.policyDecision: Tool invocation requires shared kernel assessment and exact host approval
entries.receipt: Provider acknowledgement or error hash projects to canonical lifecycle records
entries.compensation: Unknown calls require human readback and are never blindly repeated

entries.account: Named local process or remote MCP URL
entries.credential: MCP child environment is allowlisted and remote authentication stays inside transport
entries.normalization: Launch description, server name, session, target class, and SHA-256
entries.policyDecision: Transport resolution and initialization occur only within executeEffect
entries.receipt: Capabilities acknowledgement projects through the shared effect journal
entries.compensation: Failed launch closes transport; unsettled claim becomes needs human

entries.account: Isolated local plugin process and explicit host capability
entries.credential: Permission-model worker environment excludes provider and host credentials
entries.normalization: Plugin name/version/grants or request params SHA-256 plus request-scoped idempotency
entries.policyDecision: Launch and mutating host service calls share the durable gateway decision
entries.executor: Permission-contained Node worker or exact host capability operation
entries.receipt: Launch or capability acknowledgement projects to canonical effect records
entries.compensation: Worker termination or host-specific rollback; uncertain mutations need human readback

entries.credential: Scheduled child uses the shared safe environment without provider secrets
entries.normalization: Exact script SHA-256, authority id, schedule id, and fire-window key
entries.policyDecision: Missing or stale authority blocks before executeEffect; kernel decision precedes spawn
entries.receipt: Exit acknowledgement and exact script hash project to canonical lifecycle records
entries.compensation: Changed bytes invalidate authority; consequential executions are not auto-retried

entries.credential: buildSafeChildEnv excludes provider and authorization credentials
entries.normalization: Wake payload SHA-256, loop id, and exact tool call or session id
entries.policyDecision: Shared effect gate runs before background process spawn
entries.receipt: Child pid acknowledgement settles through the canonical effect journal
entries.compensation: Stable claim prevents duplicate launch after crash or replay

entries.credential: buildMcpChildEnv allowlists explicit MCP keys and excludes ambient secrets
entries.normalization: Name, command, arguments, environment-key names, tool-call id, and SHA-256
entries.policyDecision: Exact command launch is assessed and approved before transport creation
entries.receipt: Server acknowledgement projects through the canonical effect journal
entries.compensation: Child is closed on failure and unsettled launch cannot replay automatically

entries.credential: No credential access; protected compartments are denied before effect execution
entries.normalization: Compartment, commit SHA or command bytes, target, tool-call id, and SHA-256
entries.policyDecision: Protected and unscoped operations deny first; allowed narrow operations use executeEffect
entries.executor: Last-known-good marker, narrow rollback, or bounded sandbox test
entries.receipt: Exact compartment and SHA acknowledgement project to canonical records
entries.compensation: Rollback is itself narrow and approval-gated; protected brainstem and skeleton stay denied

entries.credential: Shared child-environment builder excludes provider, Google, gateway, and authorization secrets
entries.normalization: Command SHA-256, sandbox target, and exact effect call or session id
entries.policyDecision: Sandbox preparation and shared gate complete before metadata creation and spawn
entries.receipt: Background task acknowledgement projects to canonical effect records
entries.compensation: No automatic launch retry; uncertain process state requires operator inspection

entries.credential: Configured delivery resolver owns authentication; output and headers are not journaled
entries.normalization: Workflow id, output SHA-256, body SHA-256, and stable delivery key
entries.policyDecision: Missing gate blocks and provider delivery begins only after executeEffect approval
entries.receipt: Delivery acknowledgement or uncertainty projects through the shared journal
entries.compensation: No blind resend after unknown settlement; operator readback is required
